zh: 新增完整 Android App 內 OTA 更新：不再跳轉 GitHub 手動下載，App 直接下載 APK、顯示進度並在本機校驗 SHA-256 後交給 Android PackageInstaller 安裝。
首次 OTA 會自動帶到 Android「允許安裝應用程式」來源授權頁；授權後流程自動續接，後續版本不再重複要求來源權限。
安裝完成後接收 PackageInstaller 成功回調並盡力自動重新打開新版生計易；普通第三方 App 仍保留 Android 系統強制的最終安裝確認。
使用 AAP-AN00 真機完成兩輪 OTA 對抗測試：1.1.2-dev → 1.1.3-dev → 1.1.4-dev，驗證下載、SHA-256、首次來源授權、覆蓋安裝與安裝後自動回開鏈路。
修正特大字體設定會同步放大固定尺寸分享海報、導致主金額換行與明細裁切的問題；海報畫布現在固定使用標準文字比例，App 閱讀字體設定不再污染輸出圖片。
修正深色模式下分享海報預覽彈層硬編碼白底、卻繼承淺色文字而造成低對比的問題，彈層改用 Material `surface/onSurface` 語義色。
以 390×844 手機視窗、深色模式與特大字體重新實操 20 個計算器及智能精靈完整流程，確認所有入口可開啟且分享海報可正常生成。
新增海報專項回歸測試，鎖定固定畫布文字比例與深色預覽文字對比；完整 Flutter 測試擴充至 29 項並全部通過。
en: Added a complete Android in-app OTA updater: the app now downloads APKs directly, shows progress, verifies SHA-256 locally, and hands the verified package to Android PackageInstaller instead of sending users to GitHub.
The first OTA automatically opens Android's per-app install-source permission page; after approval the flow resumes, and later updates do not ask for this source permission again.
Added PackageInstaller success handling to best-effort reopen the updated Life Easy app. Android's final system installation confirmation remains mandatory for ordinary third-party apps.

Completed two real-device OTA adversarial runs on AAP-AN00: 1.1.2-dev → 1.1.3-dev → 1.1.4-dev, covering download, SHA-256 verification, first-use source permission, in-place install, and post-install relaunch.

Fixed extra-large app text scaling leaking into the fixed-size share poster, which could wrap the main amount and clip detail values. Poster rendering now uses a fixed standard text scale independent of reading preferences.
Fixed low contrast in the share-poster preview under dark mode by replacing the hard-coded white sheet with Material `surface/onSurface` semantic colors.
Re-ran all 20 calculators and the complete Smart Wizard flow at a 390×844 mobile viewport with dark mode and extra-large text, confirming every entry opens and posters render correctly.
Added dedicated poster regression coverage for fixed canvas text scaling and dark-mode preview contrast; the full Flutter suite now contains 29 passing tests.
